summary: Iteration 3 backend testing focused on the new contact-form email forwarding feature. All 7 pytest cases pass (7/7). Verified: (1) POST /api/contact returns 200 with id + created_at in <5s (non-blocking, asyncio.create_task); (2) backend logs contain 'Forwarded contact request <id> to Info@amel.de (email_id=...)' within ~1-2s of submit, confirming the Emergent email proxy accepted the message (202) and returned a non-empty id; (3) invalid email returns 422 and does not trigger a forward; (4) GET /api/contact still returns list ordered by created_at desc; (5) static inspection of server.py confirms proxy URL https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send, X-Email-Key header, from_name='Amel's Team GmbH', OWNER_EMAIL default 'Info@amel.de'.

minor.issue: test_contact_valid_returns_quickly had a stray return value — cosmetic PytestReturnNotNoneWarning, does not affect pass/fail.

critical_code_review_comments: Email forwarding is correctly fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task, and errors are swallowed with logger.error — API stays non-blocking as required.
send_email() calls _assert_safe_email() before dispatch — good defensive validation to prevent phishing-shaped emails.
OWNER_EMAIL and EMAIL_FROM_NAME are read from env with sensible defaults; EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is required (raises RuntimeError if missing) — correct.

Minor: server.py is ~300 lines — still well under the 700-line threshold, but the email helpers (_EmailScan, _assert_safe_email, _build_contact_email_html, send_email) could be moved to backend/email_utils.py for cleaner separation as the app grows.
Minor: no unit-level cleanup of the TEST_-prefixed contact_requests documents created during tests — consider a teardown fixture in a future iteration if the DB is shared.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed contact submissions created during the run (TEST_User, TEST_ForwardLog). Not cleaned up — safe because they are clearly prefixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now covers root, contact create/list, invalid-email 422, non-blocking latency (<5s), forwarded-log verification via /var/log/supervisor/backend.out.log tail, and static config inspection. Email proxy at integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send responds with 202+id — end-to-end forwarding is functional. If you need to re-verify, just re-run pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py; expect ~5s runtime.
